given.note: A3-43: a new conversation texts 'I booked a haircut for Saturday. Can I move it to 2pm?' on Thu Oct 22; the reply in that turn gives the page and sends nothing yet. On the page they type the name and the day and tap: a booking under Alex M. on Sat Oct 24 matches, so a link_record code goes to Alex's contact on file, his way (his email on file, or a text into his open chat), never back to the page. The answer is the same as when nothing matches, and says nothing about a visit; the page holds only the attempt id, and the server keeps the code's id and person with it (K-22 v1 rule 4). The tap acts for no one, so caller.personId is null.
